reason: Drizzle snapshots and journal are generated. Edit packages/core/src/db/schema.ts and run `pnpm --filter @synoikia/core db:generate`.
Migration SQL is generated by drizzle-kit. Only append data-migration statements to the migration just generated; never edit one that has shipped.
pnpm-lock.yaml is generated. Change package.json and run `pnpm install` instead.
default-repo.ts pins the synoikia-core-plugins signing key. Changing it marks every install `key_changed`; only for a compromised key.
guard-paths.json lists the files that the path guard protects. A change to it removes or adds a guard.
